purpose: Describe saved validation forecast errors; no refitting, tuning, forecast replacement or holdout scoring.
design_timing: Specified after the overall fixed-Ridge validation result was known. This is development-set diagnosis, not new independent evaluation.
primary_comparison: abs(Ridge forecast - actual) - abs(last observation forecast - actual)
observed_change_rule: actual target rent minus verified lag-1 rent; negative, zero or positive with numeric tolerance only
aggregation: Equal weight per LGA-quarter. Every group contribution is its sum of paired loss differences divided by all 589 targets.
case_examples: Ten largest and ten smallest paired loss differences, labelled retrospective selections; all 589 rows remain in scoring.
prohibitions: No final-period outcomes loaded into analysis
No filtering difficult periods out of the headline result
No oracle selection based on realised changes
No p-values or iid confidence intervals
